dishes.name: Havel pike-perch
dishes.desc: Pan-fried zander from the Havel lakes, with potatoes or in a herb sauce. The freshwater fish of the Potsdam lake district.

dishes.name: Teltower turnips
dishes.desc: Small sweet turnips from the Teltow area just outside Potsdam, usually glazed in butter. A protected regional vegetable.

dishes.name: Beelitz asparagus
dishes.desc: White asparagus from the sandy soils of Beelitz, eaten in spring with potatoes, ham and butter.

dishes.name: Potatoes with linseed oil
dishes.desc: Boiled jacket potatoes with fresh quark and cold-pressed linseed oil. A simple Brandenburg country classic.

dishes.name: Sülze with fried potatoes
dishes.desc: Jellied pork brawn with pickles and onions, served with crispy fried potatoes. Hearty traditional Brandenburg pub food.
